facts.title: shaved fennel and crushed olive salad
ingredients: 2 large fennel bulbs, tough outer leaves discarded, bulbs, stems, and fronds separated
2 tablespoons white wine or champagne vinegar
Finely grated orange zest from most of 1 orange
Pinch of crushed red pepper flakes
Kosher salt, freshly ground black pepper
3 ounces thinly shaved aged provolone cheese, or another sharp cheese, such as pecorino (about 1 cup)
facts.author: Deb Perelman
